# DropZoneController

> Handles native drag-and-drop file/data reception, dispatching `native:drop-enter`, `native:drop-leave`, and `native:drop` events.

## Constructor

```ts
new DropZoneController(host: HTMLElement, options?: DropZoneOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `accept` | `string` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `native:drop-enter` | `{ valid }` |
| `native:drop` | `{ type, files, dataTransfer }` |
| `native:drop-leave` | _(none)_ |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `attach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `detach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { DropZoneController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new DropZoneController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
